name: Choukyoushin Yuuri -Ore-sama no Niku Benki Dorei ni Shiteyaru ze!!-
original_name: 調教神ユーリ －俺様の肉便器奴隷にしてやるぜ!!－
source:
In the western continent of Meriona, 
Past the erupting volcano of Mount Gaiamarh,
There is a land that once reveled in glory.

But a great war resulted in two fronts of endless battle,
Changing the face and the circumstances of what kingdom remains.

Now the trade routes are dangerous and broken,
The people are weary and frightened.
It's time to take the fight into your hands.
You are a lone bounty hunter named Yuuri.

The adventure begins... 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE063917.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在西方大陆梅里奥纳，
越过不断喷发的盖亚马尔火山，
有一片土地曾经沉醉于往日荣光。

然而，一场大战形成了两个永无休止的战场，
彻底改变了残存王国的面貌与处境。

如今，商路危险而残破，
人们疲惫又恐惧。
是时候亲手投入战斗了。
你是名为尤里的孤独赏金猎人。

冒险就此开始……
